expectations.buyer: Machinery manufacturers, integrators, safety and conformity leaders, product counsel, and software release teams
expectations.pain: A firmware, model, PLC, or software change silently invalidates a risk assessment or creates a substantial-modification obligation before release
expectations.strongestIncumbent: PLM/QMS change control, safety lifecycle tools, OEM signature and version controls, risk assessors, notified bodies, legal counsel, and CI policy checks
expectations.biggestRisk: The legal decision is context-specific and human-authority-bound, existing change control may already route it, and code diffs alone cannot determine physical risk
